query:
# The time up to which an endpoint's copy of Wikidata has been updated, where
# the endpoint records it in the way the query service does.
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>

SELECT ?modified WHERE {
  <http://www.wikidata.org> schema:dateModified ?modified .
}
